### What Is Your Choice?
Author: Daily Disciples Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-disciples/daily-disciples-nov-7-2010-11640627.html
Passage: Jeremiah 40:4
Points:
- Nebuzaradan acknowledged God's judgment and granted Jeremiah the freedom to choose between traveling to Babylon or remaining in Judah.
- Jeremiah chose to stay behind with the impoverished remnant rather than pursue comfort or privilege in Babylon.
- Believers regularly face a similar choice between following worldly ease and staying faithful where God has called them.
- Although embracing a path marked by affliction does not come naturally, it is ultimately what is best in light of eternity.
- Followers of Christ must make a deliberate, steadfast choice to serve the Lord even through difficult circumstances.
